## first install
rc 0
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb check
sudo tee /etc/apt/preferences.d/podman-ppa
sudo apt-get update -q
sudo apt-get install -yq --fix-broken
sudo apt-get install -yq --no-install-recommends git podman netavark aardvark-dns catatonit bind9-dnsutils
sudo tee /etc/apparmor.d/usr.bin.passt
sudo apparmor_parser -r --skip-cache /etc/apparmor.d/usr.bin.passt
sudo tee <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo sysctl --system
sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo loginctl enable-linger tester
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/90-nice-dns-pin
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/pre-up.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/custom-dns-deb.service
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-nice-dns.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo cat <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/NetworkManager-wait-online.service.d/10-wait-for-connectivity.conf
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb snapshot
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/systemd/system <W>/root/usr/bin
sudo install -m 644 <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb.service <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/custom-dns-deb.service
sudo install -m 755 <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable custom-dns-deb.service
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d
sudo tee <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-nice-dns.conf
sudo tee <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/90-nice-dns-pin
sudo chmod 755 <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/90-nice-dns-pin
sudo test -e <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/91-nice-dns-ipv6 enp1s0 record
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/91-nice-dns-ipv6 wg0-mullvad record
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/pre-up.d
sudo install -m 755 <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/91-nice-dns-ipv6 <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo install -m 755 <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/91-nice-dns-ipv6 <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/pre-up.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo systemctl reload NetworkManager
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d
sudo tee <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo sysctl --system
sudo test -x <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6 enp1s0 up
sudo <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6 wg0-mullvad up
sudo <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb ipv6-profiles
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/default/grub.d/99-nice-dns-ipv6.cfg
sudo <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb pin
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb status
sudo <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb ipv6-profiles-done

sudo cat <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-nice-dns.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo cat <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo cat <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/NetworkManager-wait-online.service.d/10-wait-for-connectivity.conf
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb snapshot
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/usr/bin
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/90-nice-dns-pin
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/pre-up.d
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/dispatcher.d/pre-up.d/91-nice-dns-ipv6
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/systemd/system
sudo install -m 644 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/custom-dns-deb.service
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d
sudo install -m 644 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/NetworkManager/conf.d/90-nice-dns.conf
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d
sudo install -m 644 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-nice-dns-disable-ipv6.conf
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d
sudo install -m 644 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/sysctl.d/99-podman-privileged-ports.conf
sudo rm -f <W>/root/etc/systemd/system/NetworkManager-wait-online.service.d/10-wait-for-connectivity.conf
sudo systemctl reload NetworkManager
## uninstall
rc 0
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/deb/custom-dns-deb restore
sudo rm -f <W>/root/usr/bin/custom-dns-deb
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/default/grub.d/99-nice-dns-ipv6.cfg
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo rm -f <W>/root/usr/libexec/nice-dns-helper <W>/root/usr/libexec/nice-dns/root-ops <W>/root/usr/libexec/nice-dns/.root-ops.new <W>/root/usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.nice-dns.policy
sudo test -d <W>/root/usr/libexec/nice-dns
